Select canonical_smiles, chembl_id, standard_type, standard_relation, standard_value, and standard_units for all activity rows in assay CHEMBL3885863 that have an exact measurement (standard_relation '=' and standard_value is not null). Join activities to assays on assay_id, filter by assay chembl_id CHEMBL3885863, join to molecule_dictionary on molregno, and join to compound_structures on molregno. Keep all qualifying activity rows without deduplication. Sort by canonical_smiles, chembl_id, standard_type, standard_relation, standard_value, and standard_units.
